label_en: Culture house / makerspace / studios / gallery / rehearsal rooms
summary: A cluster of cultural production and display spaces: artists' studios (ateljéer), shared workshops and makerspace (wood, metal, textile, digital fabrication), a gallery or exhibition room, and music rehearsal rooms (replokaler). No Swedish law is specific to these uses and no national space norm was found. Requirements come from generic rules: fire class depending on whether users know the premises (members: Vk 1; public gallery or open house: Vk 2A/2B); sound insulation (BFS 2024:10, functional for lokaler; 56 dB minimum to dwellings), which is decisive for rehearsal rooms; workplace and machine safety for staffed workshops (AFS); ventilation and fire safety for fumes, dust and flammable goods (LBE 2010:1011). These uses are among the most tolerant of office-building constraints (moderate loads, small rooms, deep plans acceptable for studios without permanent occupancy), except for loud music, heavy machines and kilns.

regulatory.bbr_verksamhetsklass: Mixed. Studios and workshops used by members with good knowledge of the premises can be argued as Vk 1 (BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 10 §, like offices; assessment, not sourced). A gallery, open workshop or public events is Vk 2A (max 150) or 2B (more than 150) (2 kap. 11–12 §§). Rehearsal rooms are Vk 1 for regular members, or Vk 2A if used for audiences. See cross_cutting.json fire_vk_2abc.

key_laws.ref: BFS 2024:10 skydd mot buller: 2 kap. 2 § tabell 2:1, 5 § tabell 2:4, 9 §
BFS 2024:8 hygien, hälsa och miljö: 3 kap. 4 § (removal of pollutants from the intended use), 4 kap. 3 § (daylight in lokaler)
AFS 2023:12 Utformning av arbetsplatser (staffed workshops; 3 kap. 7 § separate rooms for particular risks)
Lag (2010:1011) om brandfarliga och explosiva varor (LBE): gases for welding and brazing, solvents (thresholds in MSB regulations, not verified here)
Folkhälsomyndighetens allmänna råd om höga ljudnivåer (FoHMFS 2014:15)

permits: Bygglov for change of use from office (PBL 9 kap. 2 § första stycket 3 a) where the new use is 'väsentligen annat'. Studios used as offices for creative work may not need it (assessment by the byggnadsnämnd).
Permit for flammable gases or liquids above MSB thresholds (LBE permit regime; paragraph numbers and threshold values not verified here).
Detaljplan: workshops with noise or dust may conflict with housing or office plans; check permitted use (e.g. C, K, J småindustri). Not verified.
regulatory.operator_oversight: Kommunens byggnadsnämnd; räddningstjänsten (LBE permits, LSO); miljö- och hälsoskyddsnämnd (noise, emissions); Arbetsmiljöverket (staffed workshops)

gross_m2_per_unit.source: No Swedish law, guidance or public programme found that gives m2 per artist, member or rehearsal band.

egress_design_density.source: Repealed BBR general advice, practice: BBR tabell 5:333 'Museum, konsthall' 0.25 persons/m2 (gallery). Studios and workshops: furnished maximum (BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 4 §). Vernissage or events use the samlingslokal default 2.5 p/m2.

occupancy.hourly_presence_note: Modelling assumption (indicative, not sourced). Studios used by day by professional artists; makerspace and rehearsal rooms peak in the evening and at weekends. Rehearsal rooms are often booked until 22–23.

required.basis: Defining space; not regulated. If used as a permanent workplace by employees, AFS 2023:12 applies; for self-employed artists, BFS 2024:8 4 kap. 3 § applies (rooms in lokaler where people stay more than temporarily need sufficient daylight and view unless unreasonable).

spaces.shareable_note: Studio clusters often sit beside coworking. Clean studios (illustration, design) are close to office use.
spaces.notes: Office floors suit studios well: facade-adjacent cellular offices become studios with little intervention (high reversibility). Painting with solvents needs extract ventilation (BFS 2024:8 3 kap. 4 §).

spaces.label_en: Shared workshop / makerspace (wood, metal, textile, digital fabrication)

required.basis: Not required. Where staffed, AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 7 § (processes with particular risks normally in separate rooms) and machine rules apply. Process ventilation and dust extraction follow from BFS 2024:8 3 kap. 4 § and AFS 2023:12 5 kap.

spaces.shareable_note: Schools (slöjd) and study associations can book workshop time; evening members.
spaces.notes: Heavy machines and material stacks: storage loads E1 5.0 kN/m2 (BFS 2024:6 tabell 4:1) vs office 2.5; machine bases may need local strengthening. Wood dust (explosion and fire risk) and welding fumes need local extraction; welding gases fall under LBE. Machine noise and vibration to neighbours (BFS 2024:10). Goods access (lift or ground floor, wide doors) is often decisive. Ceiling height of 2,700 mm is guidance only (AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 5 § allmänna råd).

required.basis: Optional. If present, fire separation and ventilation follow from BFS 2024:7 (fire cells) and BFS 2024:8 3 kap. 4 §; flammable products under LBE.

spaces.notes: Ceramic kilns need high power supply and exhaust; spray painting needs a separate fire cell and exhaust. Facade or roof access for exhaust is the typical binding constraint in office conversions (indicative).

required.basis: Required only if the programme includes music, but then sound insulation is law: BFS 2024:10 2 kap. 9 § (lokaler: dampen noise to the extent the intended use requires) and, where dwellings adjoin, tabell 2:1 (DnT,w,50 at least 56 dB from lokaler) and tabell 2:4 (L'nT,w,50 at most 52 dB). Miljöbalken 9 kap. nuisance rules apply in operation.

size.source: No Swedish public source found for rehearsal-room size.

spaces.shareable_note: Kulturskola by day, bands in the evening. Only if box-in-box construction is in place.
spaces.notes: Amplified band rehearsal far exceeds what the 56 dB building minimum is designed for. Box-in-box rooms (floating floor, independent walls and ceiling) are standard practice (engineering judgement, indicative), costing floor area and height and loading the slab. Best placed in basements or on slab-on-grade, away from dwellings and sleeping rooms. Musicians' exposure: FoHMFS 2014:15 (audiences) and AFS rules on noise at work (not opened). Windowless rooms are acceptable when the use is temporary per room (no daylight needed under BFS 2024:8 4 kap. 3 § where unreasonable for the intended use).

required.basis: Optional. If open to the public it is a publik lokal: accessible (BFS 2024:12 2 kap.) and Vk 2A/2B.

spaces.shareable_note: A shared lobby or library foyer can host exhibitions.
spaces.notes: Load C3 'without obstacles for moving persons' 3.0 kN/m2 (BFS 2024:6 tabell 4:1), slightly above office B 2.5; heavy sculptures need local checks. Egress density 0.25 p/m2 (repealed BBR advice, practice), or 2.5 p/m2 at vernissage. Street-level facade is valuable for visibility. 2,700 mm is guidance (repealed BBR 3:3112 for publika lokaler; AFS allmänna råd).

spaces.label_en: Material and artwork storage, goods access
spaces.shareable_note: Goods lift and loading bay shared with other tenants.

spaces.label_en: WCs, wash-up sink and staff/member facilities

required.basis: FMH 35 § (sufficient toilets); BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 7 § (accessible public WC if public WCs exist); AFS 2023:12 for staff. See cross_cutting.json sanitary and staff_facilities.

spaces.notes: Clay and plaster traps on sinks in ceramic and sculpture workshops (practice).

variants.label: Studio cluster (ateljéhus)
variants.changes: Mostly individual studios along the facade, shared wash-up and storage. Closest to office use; minimal fire or acoustic change.

variants.label: Open makerspace / fablab
variants.changes: Public or member workshop with machines, laser cutters and 3D printers. Ventilation and extraction, goods access and machine safety bind. Vk 2A if open to the public.

variants.label: Rehearsal house (replokaler)
variants.changes: Box-in-box rooms, basement or ground floor preferred. Noise to dwellings is the hard constraint.

variants.label: Culture house (kulturhus) with gallery and event room
variants.changes: Adds a gallery (publik lokal) and an event room (see assembly_event), often combined with library and community_hybrid.

typical_blockers: Music: BFS 2024:10 minima to dwellings (56 dB DnT,w,50; 52 dB L'nT,w,50) do not cover amplified music. Box-in-box rooms are needed, costing height and load.
Workshops: dust and fume extraction, hot work and flammable goods (LBE), and machine noise and vibration in a building designed for quiet office work.
Goods handling (sheet materials, artworks) on upper floors without a goods lift.
Storage and machine loads (E1 5.0 kN/m2) vs office 2.5 kN/m2.
typical_enablers: Cellular office rooms convert directly to studios (high reversibility, low cost).
Deep interior zones suit storage, darkrooms and rehearsal rooms that need no daylight.
Basement or ground floor and former garages suit workshops and rehearsal.
Moderate public density (gallery 0.25 p/m2, repealed advice) rarely binds egress.

sources.ref: BFS 2024:10 buller: 2 kap. 2, 5, 9 §§ (text extracted from PDF)

open_questions: No Swedish public programme for ateljéhus, makerspace or replokaler was found (municipal kulturförvaltning or KRO/Konstnärernas Riksorganisation could have studio guidance; Studiefrämjandet/Sensus for rehearsal rooms). Not searched in depth.
LBE permit thresholds for welding gases and solvents (MSB föreskrifter) were not verified.
Vk 1 vs Vk 2A for member-only studios and workshops is an assessment; confirm with Boverket guidance.
Folkhälsomyndigheten FoHMFS 2014:13 (buller inomhus) values for dwellings next to music rooms were not verified; add them if the fit test needs operational limits.
AFS rules on noise exposure for staff and musicians (and their current AFS number after the 2025 restructuring) were not opened.
